normalization: ID-2 applied; normalized one-based positions; no split entries; raw positions = normalized positions
surfactantArchitecture: SLES (2) defining; hydroxysultaine (3) and coco-glucoside (5) buffers; C1 -> moderate.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether/sulfonate chassis - defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine (3) and Coco-Glucoside (5); no prominent reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Kaolin (8) is clay - not a cleansing route (C3); no reinforcing anionic. Nothing realistic moves the C1 reading.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system - prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (9) - plus light humectant routes (Sodium Hyaluronate 6, Niacinamide 7).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone, no lipid, no pearlizer; absorbent Kaolin (8) works against slip. Cleansing-led architecture argues toward low.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: a single light cationic polymer is the only deposition route, facing an effective C1 reset plus absorbent clay; no residue mechanism that would reduce lift.

depositionLoad.rationale: Only one deposition family: a single cationic guar (9).

persistence.rationale: Guar alone in an SLES base is weakly retained; humectants are not deposition.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES with two buffers; Kaolin adds absorbent character.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low: a single light cationic polymer is the only deposition route, facing an effective C1 reset plus absorbent clay; no residue mechanism that would reduce lift.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: only one deposition family, no silicone, lipid, protein or film former to converge with the guar (single family facing moderate reset, W2/6.6 'no polymer floor').
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: None material; guar charge/level unknown but cannot plausibly create noticeable residue alone.
